name: Toggl Track
description: Toggl Track is a time tracking tool for individuals and teams that turns one-click timers and background activity into reports on profitability, productivity, and billable hours across projects and clients.
best_for: Positioned for teams of any size that need to track billable hours, project profitability, and productivity, with an open API and 100+ integrations including Jira, Salesforce, and Asana.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Free forever for up to 3 users. Manual and real-time timers, calendar integrations, and personal insights. No team reports, billable rates, or SSO.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: $9/user/month billed annually, or $12/user/month billed monthly. Adds billable rates, team reports, and timeline views.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: $16/user/month billed annually, or $24/user/month billed monthly. Adds profitability reports, labor costs, timesheet approvals, and SSO.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Contact sales. Adds a dedicated customer success manager and custom roles.

cons: The advertised $9/user (Starter) and $16/user (Premium) rates require paying annually upfront; month-to-month billing costs 33% more at $12 and $24 per user/month respectively.
Team-level reports, billable rates, and capacity-planning features are entirely absent from the Free plan, even for small paid-client work.
SSO is gated to the Premium tier only, at $16-24 per user/month, and is unavailable on Free or Starter.
features: One-click timer across web, desktop, mobile, and browser extension
Background activity tracking that converts app and website usage into time entries
Calendar view with the ability to import calendar events

alternatives.name: Clockify
alternatives.description: A time tracking and timesheet app for teams, with reporting, scheduling, and a free unlimited-user plan.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting free time tracking for unlimited users

alternatives.name: Hubstaff
alternatives.description: A workforce management and time tracking tool with automated timesheets, activity monitoring, and payroll integrations.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing workforce proof-of-work tracking, scheduling, and automated payroll

alternatives.name: Asana
alternatives.description: A project management platform for planning, tracking, and reporting on team work.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want project management alongside light time tracking via integrations
